title: A Novel De Novo STAG1 Variant at the RAD21 Binding Interface Is Associated With Hypoglycemia, Recurrent Fever, Immunodeficiency and Features of Classical Cohesinopathies.
authors: Hussain, Hafiz Muhammad Jafar; Zimmermann, Michael; Safgren, Stephanie L; Farris, Joseph D; Panwar, Deepak; Thurman, Sarah Allen; Muthusamy, Karthik; Urrutia, Raul; Wick, Myra J; E Vairo, Filippo Pinto; Klee, Eric W
one_liner_zh: 该文报道STAG1新发变异致黏连蛋白病，用分子动力学模拟评估变异对RAD21结合界面的影响，虽涉及染色质相关蛋白复合物模拟，但核心是临床病例与变异致病性，非三维基因组/染色质组织建模。
abstract: The cohesin complex, composed of SMC1, SMC3, RAD21, and STAG1/STAG2, is essential for chromosome cohesion, DNA repair, and transcriptional regulation. Pathogenic variants in cohesin components cause cohesinopathies. The classical characteristics of cohesinopathies include developmental delay (DD), intellectual disability (ID), feeding difficulties, hypotonia, short stature, hearing loss, and dysmorphic features. Here, we present a 5-year-old boy with classical cohesinopathy features, including DD/ID and feeding difficulties, along with non-classical features such as hypoglycemia, recurrent fever, and immunodeficiency. Trio exome sequencing identified a novel de novo missense variant of uncertain significance (NM_005862.3:c.643G>A(p.Val215Ile)) in the STAG1 gene. The variant localizes to the RAD21 interaction interface, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations revealed conformational changes comparable to other STAG1 variants reported as likely pathogenic in patients, supporting a deleterious effect which may disrupt the STAG1-RAD21 interaction interface. This case expands the phenotypic and molecular spectrum of STAG1-related cohesinopathy and advances our understanding of the disease mechanism.
abstract_zh: 黏连蛋白复合体（cohesin complex）由SMC1、SMC3、RAD21和STAG1/STAG2组成，对于染色体黏连、DNA修复和转录调控至关重要。黏连蛋白组分的致病性变异可导致黏连蛋白病（cohesinopathies）。黏连蛋白病的典型特征包括发育迟缓（DD）、智力障碍（ID）、喂养困难、肌张力低下、身材矮小、听力损失和畸形特征。在此，我们报告一名5岁男孩，具有典型的黏连蛋白病特征，包括DD/ID和喂养困难，同时伴有非典型特征，如低血糖、反复发热和免疫缺陷。三人外显子组测序在STAG1基因中鉴定出一个新的新生错义变异，意义未明（NM_005862.3:c.643G>A(p.Val215Ile)）。该变异定位于RAD21相互作用界面，分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟显示其构象变化与患者中报告为可能致病的其他STAG1变异相当，支持其可能破坏STAG1-RAD21相互作用界面的有害效应。本例扩展了STAG1相关黏连蛋白病的表型和分子谱系，并增进了我们对该疾病机制的理解。
